title: ICJ orders Rafah crossing kept open
summary: The Court added a provisional measure addressing humanitarian access through the Rafah crossing.
claim: The Court ordered Israel to maintain open the Rafah crossing for the unhindered provision at scale of urgently needed basic services and humanitarian assistance.
legal_characterization: Binding provisional measure in an ICJ case; no final merits determination.
source_title: Order of 24 May 2024, Application of the Genocide Convention in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel)
verification_notes: Verified against the cited ICJ order, including its operative clause. This is a binding provisional measure at an interim stage; it is not a final merits finding that genocide occurred.
